remarks:
Beachfront living at its finest in the desirable Harrysborg cul-de-sac in the City of Dunkirk! This beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-bath home is in exceptional condition inside and out and offers breathtaking panoramic views of Lake Erie. The first floor features two bedrooms and a brand-new full bath with a walk-in shower, along with a spacious dining room and living room showcasing stunning lake views. The gorgeous woodburning fireplace with gas logs creates a warm and inviting focal point.

The brand-new kitchen is truly impressive, featuring a large island, stainless steel appliances, Thermador gas range and convenient pot filler. First-floor laundry/mudroom includes built-in cabinetry, countertop workspace and a double beverage refrigerator.

Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms and two updated full baths. The spacious primary suite includes a sitting area leading to a private balcony overlooking the lake, plus a beautiful primary bath with both a shower and jetted tub. A second-level loft provides the perfect space for a home office, with abundant closet and storage space. An additional room offers excellent flexibility as a media room, hobby space or additional storage.

Enjoy the lake lifestyle with an outdoor shower and spectacular beachfront setting! Additional features include luxury vinyl flooring, James Hardie cement siding, blacktop driveway, and an abundance of storage. Brand-new roof installed May 2026 and brand-new high-velocity central A/C installed July 2026! A rare opportunity to own a beautifully updated beachfront home in one of Dunkirk's sought-after lakefront neighborhoods!
